text:
sam_support: quick handoff -> CS for TidalHealth trial. Onboarding stalled: bulk ingest returning intermittent 412/timeout and similarity scores dropped ~19%. Activation down to 29%. Sales touch scheduled in 3 days. Need CS bridge + a short customer-facing update ASAP.

kevin_se: Reproduced on their tenant. Root cause looks like a recent input-preprocessor change that altered chunk boundaries for PDFs, causing embedding drift and worker backpressure. Applied tenant-scoped throttle and disabled the preprocessor flag for TidalHealth. Rolling revert queued. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/11421

ana_csm: I'll take customer lead and run the bridge. Can someone paste a one-paragraph non-tech blurb I can send pre-call? Scheduling 30m at 2pm PT. @luke_csm_head FYI  if we don't stabilize before the sales check, we should prep renewal mitigation.

luke_csm_head: Acknowledged. Prepare renewal play options: (1) 1-week trial extension, (2) one-time account credit, (3) prioritized enablement + doc export for audit. Ana, capture sentiment and any immediate asks on the call.

kevin_se: Customer-facing snippet: "We're reverting a recent document-processing change for your tenant and have applied a temporary stabilization to ingestion. Expect measurable improvements within ~30 minutes; we'll review live on the bridge and follow with a remediation timeline."

sam_support: Pushed logs to thread. Key extracts: `ingest::412 backpressure at 2026-06-14T14:52:10Z`, `embed_sim_baseline 0.90 -> 0.73 after preproc change`. Also included small repro script.

oncall_incident_bot: Incident 11421 created and escalated to CS. Priority: P2. Bridge scheduled: 2026-06-14T14:00:00-07:00. Engineering oncall looped.

luke_csm_head: Comms plan owners: immediate customer ping = Ana, bridge + technical RCA = Kevin + Sam, post-call remediation & credits = Luke. If activation remains <30% after 24h, loop in sales_exec and trigger exec outreach.

ana_csm: Sending invite + short message now. Also will ask the customer if they'd like an export of pre-change embeddings for comparison.

kevin_se: Runbook rollback snippet for ops: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal/api/admin/tenants/rollback -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"tenant":"tidalhealth","target":"preproc-v1"}'
```

sales_exec: Looping in sales; prep note for renewal play. If we offer an extension, prefer 7 days + prioritized enablement.

sam_support: Invite sent to customer and the CS owners. I'll join early to stream logs and confirm stabilization.

ana_csm: Great. After the bridge I'll update the renewal risk flag and attach a short feedback survey: https://redwood.feedback/s/tidal-onboard (1	6 scale). If they request credits, I'll route to Luke for approval. :thumbsup:
